note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 12 corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation, operations, or release.

evidence_requirements.title: Implementation evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Version, commit, build record, and dependency manifest.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: A successful build is not a proven deployment path.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A build log is not verification evidence.
evidence_requirements.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated on source or dependency change.

evidence_requirements.title: Unit and component verification evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Test identity, version, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Absence of observed failure is not absence of defect.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: Coverage percentage is not correctness evidence.

evidence_requirements.title: PostgreSQL behavioural verification evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.required_evidence_classes: Automated test evidence; manual test evidence.
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Database state, version, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Behaviour observed is bounded by the data context used.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: An ORM mock is not physical database behaviour.
evidence_requirements.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated on schema or configuration change.

evidence_requirements.title: Contract and integration testing evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Contract version, environment, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Contract conformance is bounded by the contracts tested.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A unit test is not an integration test.

evidence_requirements.title: End-to-end workflow testing evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.required_evidence_classes: Automated test evidence; manual test evidence.
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Workflow identity, environment, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Workflow coverage is bounded by scenarios exercised.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A component test is not a workflow test.

evidence_requirements.title: Security evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Assessment scope, version, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Security testing is not privacy or legal compliance.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A scan is not a manual security review.

evidence_requirements.title: Privacy and records evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Assessment scope and record.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: A privacy assessment is not legal compliance.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: Security evidence is not privacy evidence.

evidence_requirements.title: Accessibility evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Procedure, assistive-technology context, and observation record.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: An automated scan is not a conformance determination.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: An automated accessibility scan is not manual evidence.

evidence_requirements.title: Bilingual semantic-equivalence evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Semantic review record.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: String presence is not semantic equivalence.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A translation memory match is not semantic evidence.

evidence_requirements.title: Financial controls and reconciliation evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Reconciliation record and control assessment.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: A reconciliation is bounded by the period reconciled.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A report is not a reconciliation.

evidence_requirements.title: Data integrity evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Integrity check record and data context.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Integrity is bounded by the checks applied.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A row count is not an integrity proof.
evidence_requirements.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated on data or schema change.

evidence_requirements.title: Migration evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Stage, batch, source authority, and reconciliation record.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Migration execution is not migration acceptance.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A rehearsal is not a cutover.

evidence_requirements.title: Backup, restore, and recovery evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Exercise scope, environment, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Backup completed is not backup restorable.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A backup log is not a restore proof.

evidence_requirements.title: Continuity evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Scenario, environment, and result artifact.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: A single exercise is not sustained continuity.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A plan is not an exercise.

evidence_requirements.title: Observability and incident-response evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Signal, alert, and response record.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: A signal defined is not a signal proven.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A dashboard is not an incident exercise.

evidence_requirements.title: Provider operations evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Provider certification scope, effective period, and artifact.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Provider certification is not end-to-end assurance.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A provider report is not end-to-end proof.

evidence_requirements.title: Training and competence evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Competence assessment record.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Training delivered is not competence achieved.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: Attendance is not competence.
evidence_requirements.expiry_or_revalidation_dependency: Revalidated on role or content change.

evidence_requirements.title: Adoption evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Adoption measure record.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Onboarding is not sustained adoption.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: A launch is not adoption.

evidence_requirements.title: Business acceptance evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Business-owner decision record.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: Business acceptance is bounded by reviewed evidence.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: Stakeholder support is not accountable approval.

evidence_requirements.title: Independent assurance evidence requirement
evidence_requirements.minimum_provenance: Independent-assurance summary record.
evidence_requirements.independence_requirement: Independent of owner, executor, and acceptance authority.
evidence_requirements.known_evidentiary_limitations: An assurance conclusion is bounded by its inputs.
evidence_requirements.prohibited_substitution: An assurance conclusion is not the underlying evidence.
